theory.intro: Duration problems ask you to find a start time, finish time, or how long something lasts. Work in both $12$-hour (am/pm) and $24$-hour notation.
facts: To convert pm times to $24$-hour, add $12$ to the hour: $3{:}30$ pm $= 15{:}30$. Midnight is $00{:}00$, noon is $12{:}00$.
When minutes pass $60$, carry $1$ hour; when hours pass $24$, the time crosses midnight into the next day.
steps: Decide whether you need the start, finish, or duration.
Add or subtract hours first, then minutes, carrying at $60$ minutes.
Write the answer in the notation asked for.

foundation.question_text:
A movie starts at $6{:}35$ pm and lasts $1$ hour $50$ minutes.
When does it finish?
foundation.solution_text:
$6{:}35\text{ pm}+1\text{ h}=7{:}35\text{ pm}$
$7{:}35\text{ pm}+50\text{ min}=8{:}25\text{ pm}$

foundation.question_text:
A training session finishes at $17{:}20$ after lasting $1$ hour $35$ minutes.
When did it start?

A train leaves at $09{:}48$ and arrives at $11{:}12$.
Find the journey duration.

A $55$-minute class starts at $10{:}30$ am.
A $15$-minute break follows.
When does the break end?

A ferry journey lasts $2$ hours $10$ minutes and arrives at $0030$.
Find its departure time.
foundation.solution_text:
$0030-2\text{ h}=2230$
$2230-10\text{ min}=2220$
The ferry left at $2220$ on the previous day.

foundation.question_text:
A workshop runs from $1{:}15$ pm to $4{:}00$ pm with a $30$-minute break.
How much working time is there?
foundation.solution_text:
$1{:}15\text{ pm}\to4{:}00\text{ pm}=2\text{ h }45\text{ min}$
$2\text{ h }45\text{ min}-30\text{ min}$
$=2\text{ h }15\text{ min}$

development.question_text:
A bus leaves at $2245$, travels for $1$ hour $55$ minutes, stops for $20$ minutes, then travels another $35$ minutes.
When does it arrive?
development.solution_text:
$2245+1\text{ h }55\text{ min}=0040$
$0040+20\text{ min}=0100$
$0100+35\text{ min}=0135$
The bus arrives at $0135$ the next day.

development.question_text:
A concert begins at $7{:}25$ pm.
Two sets last $55$ minutes and $1$ hour $10$ minutes, with a $25$-minute interval.
When does the concert end?
development.solution_text:
$55\text{ min}+1\text{ h }10\text{ min}+25\text{ min}$
$=2\text{ h }30\text{ min}$
$7{:}25\text{ pm}+2\text{ h }30\text{ min}$
$=9{:}55\text{ pm}$

development.question_text:
A hiker walks from $0815$ to $1040$, rests for $35$ minutes, then walks for another $1$ hour $20$ minutes.
What is the total walking time?
development.solution_text:
$0815\to1040=2\text{ h }25\text{ min}$
$2\text{ h }25\text{ min}+1\text{ h }20\text{ min}$
$=3\text{ h }45\text{ min}$
The rest is not included in walking time.

development.question_text:
A plane is scheduled to depart at $14{:}50$ and arrive at $17{:}05$.
It departs $25$ minutes late but the journey still takes the scheduled duration.
When does it arrive?

A machine starts at $09{:}35$, runs for $2$ hours $45$ minutes, pauses for $25$ minutes, then runs for another $50$ minutes.
When does it stop?
development.solution_text:
$2\text{ h }45\text{ min}+25\text{ min}+50\text{ min}$
$=4\text{ h}$
$09{:}35+4\text{ h}=13{:}35$

development.question_text:
A race began at $11{:}52$ pm and ended at $1{:}18$ am.
A runner paused for $7$ minutes.
How long was the runner moving?
development.solution_text:
$11{:}52\text{ pm}\to1{:}18\text{ am}=1\text{ h }26\text{ min}$
$1\text{ h }26\text{ min}-7\text{ min}$
$=1\text{ h }19\text{ min}$

mastery.question_text:
A factory cycle starts at $21{:}38$.
Stage A lasts $1$ hour $47$ minutes, cleaning lasts $28$ minutes, and Stage B lasts $2$ hours $16$ minutes.
When does the cycle finish?
mastery.solution_text:
$1\text{ h }47\text{ min}+28\text{ min}+2\text{ h }16\text{ min}$
$=4\text{ h }31\text{ min}$
$21{:}38+4\text{ h }31\text{ min}$
$=02{:}09$
The cycle finishes at $02{:}09$ the next day.

mastery.question_text:
A traveller must arrive by $0645$.
The trip takes $2$ hours $38$ minutes and they plan a $22$-minute stop.
What is the latest departure time?

A $24$-hour event has three sessions lasting $2$ hours $15$ minutes, $1$ hour $50$ minutes and $1$ hour $35$ minutes.
Find the total session time.
mastery.solution_text:
$2\text{ h }15\text{ min}+1\text{ h }50\text{ min}+1\text{ h }35\text{ min}$
$=5\text{ h }40\text{ min}$
